sources.limitations: The diode voltage budget is a design allowance. ESR computation applies at the cited frequency/temperature. The IG thermal allowance is not a guaranteed bound at every intermediate load. Verify voltage, stability and case temperature on the built fixture at 6V and 15V.
sources.TLC555_R3: TI SLFS043K (rev. January 2026) 5.5/5.6: VOH min 1.5 V typ 1.9 V at VDD 2 V, IOH -300 uA; VOH min 4.1 V typ 4.8 V at VDD 5 V, IOH -1 mA; IDD max 500 uA at 5 V (TLC555C). Ro = (VDD - VOH)/IOH: typ 200 / 333 ohm, at min VOH 900 / 1667 ohm. The 3.3 V value lies between; both ends are evaluated.
